**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record PrinterDetails
```

What a printer reports about itself beyond printing: its web pages, pictures of it, its firmware, and how it can be identified.

An empty list, or a `null` value, means the print system didn't say. IPP Everywhere printers report most of these; the Windows spooler reports none, so a Windows queue has them only through its IPP printer.

The web addresses come from the printer and are only `http` or `https`. Treat them as the printer's own say-so: an application that fetches an icon should expect it from the printer's host, and not trust it more than it trusts the printer.

### Firmware

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<PrinterFirmware> Firmware { get; init; }
```

Gets the parts of the printer's firmware and their versions.

### Icons

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<Uri> Icons { get; init; }
```

Gets pictures of the printer, smallest first, as IPP Everywhere printers list them: 48, 128 and 512 pixels square, as PNG.

### IdentifyActions

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<IdentifyAction> IdentifyActions { get; init; }
```

Gets the ways the printer can make itself known with [IPrinter.IdentifyAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#identifyasync). Empty if it can't be identified, or didn't say.

### PrinterId

```csharp
public required string PrinterId { get; init; }
```

Gets the identifier of the printer described, as in [PrinterInfo.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerinfo/#id).

### SuppliesWebPage

```csharp
public Uri? SuppliesWebPage { get; init; }
```

Gets a web page where the printer's supplies, such as ink or toner, are shown or ordered, or `null` if not reported.

### WebPage

```csharp
public Uri? WebPage { get; init; }
```

Gets the printer's own web page, usually where it is set up, or `null` if not reported. For a CUPS queue, it is the queue's page on the CUPS server.
